description: Apply the master spread parent_name (full name with prefix, e.g. "A-Footer") to page_id, or to several pages at once with page_ids (both may be given; every page is checked before anything changes). "[None]", "none" or "Ohne" detaches the page from its master – an ad page loses header, footer line and page number in one step. Returns page_id and parent_applied (of the first page) as InDesign reports it afterwards, and pages[] {page_id, parent_applied} for every page.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

page_id.description: Page from list_pages (or a master page from list_parent_pages). Required unless page_ids is given.

page_ids.description: Several pages at once (from list_pages), e.g. all pages of a chapter.

parent_name.description: Full master name with prefix, or "[None]" to detach.

name: apply_parent_to_page
title: Apply a master page
